scope: One finite source-neutral opaque exterior first-hit diagnostic; no render/model edit/photo acceptance

positive_X.offset_rule: 20% of smaller native eye Y/Z extent; diagnostic ray layout, no geometry modification

negative_X.offset_rule: 20% of smaller native eye Y/Z extent; diagnostic ray layout, no geometry modification

limits: Neutral glTF rest/source geometry only; no current animated/GPU/world visibility qualification
Exterior origins are source-model projection proofs, not original saved camera positions
Material and UV identity locate the visible source surface; they do not prove that its tissue is cornea rather than closed eyelid
OPAQUE/doubleSided material assumptions are recorded per actual first hit; no shader overrides or holes
Ray hits preserve exact original primitive/face/vertex/accessor IDs; no automatic ocular patch selection or edits
